name: Hoax
summary: Secret-identity deduction game where players bluff about roles to gather resources, investigate clues, and eliminate others.
rules_text: Each player gets a secret Character card; extra characters are removed. Resource tokens and a suspicion deck of matching character cards are placed center. On your turn you must Claim, may Investigate any number, and may Accuse once. Claim: announce "I am X" and use X's privilege to gain resource tokens. You may lie. Any other player may call Hoax by taking the hoax card; all non-active players discuss then vote thumbs up/down. If majority down, claimant states if truthful; false claimant gets impostor token and loses turn, true claimants penalize accusers. Investigate: pay one of each resource, target a player; target removes his own character card plus 3 random suspicion cards, shuffles them, shows privately to investigator. Accuse: give target facedown the guessed character card; if correct target eliminated and gives resources to accuser, if wrong accuser eliminated. Last player remaining wins.
rating_reason: Hidden identity deduction bluffing elimination game perfect for engine
